game_title: Exponent Engine – Ash Rim Trail Defense
game_concept: A survival strategy set in Mt. Pyre – Ash Rim Trail, the crumbling rim of Mt. Pyre: the fire warden must handle magma slimes while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Exponent Engine: Use ** to power up engines: level 3 should deliver 2**3 energy.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Ash Rim Trail: the crumbling rim of Mt. Pyre
core_gameplay_loop: In Ash Rim Trail, repeat each round: Use ** to power up engines: level 3 should deliver 2**3 energy. Each round, magma slimes strike the magma valve, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the engine_power value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the magma valve from magma slimes in Ash Rim Trail: keep the engine_power meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 45-second timer ends.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: engine_power drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 45-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 6 (applied tier): Exponent Engine
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Exponent Engine' (Week 2 slot 11), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Ash Rim Trail'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Mt. Pyre

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how engine_power changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against magma slimes in Ash Rim Trail.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 45 seconds while engine_power > 0.
